answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 39552 Country: India Title: Is there any reference of hadith that doing wudhu with cold water in cold weather will give us more virtues in comparison of searching warm water Question: Is there any reference of hadith that doing wudhu with cold water in cold weather will give us more virtues in comparison of searching warm water? What if warm water/geyser is easily available, but still doing wudhu with cold water just to get more virtues? Harming our nafs is allowed in Islam or not. Answer ID: 39552 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1197/1197/M=1433) We could not find any such hadith. Yes, it is not lawful to put oneself in danger. It is also not forbidden to use hot water but if one makes wudhu with cold water in the presence of hot water in order to get more reward and there is no fear of loss, then it is hoped that one shall get more reward due to extra suffering. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
